title: Firmware emulator
description: Run local SP-404MKII firmware in independent browser sessions and inspect CPU, display and virtual USB traces.
introduction: Load a firmware file from your computer. Run independent sessions to compare builds, inspect execution and exchange virtual USB reports.
researchLimit: Research build. Peripheral coverage is incomplete. Results here need separate hardware verification for boot, recovery, audio and firmware updates.
localNote: Firmware stays in this browser. The runtime downloads when you press Start. This page has no connection to a physical SP.
noScript: JavaScript is required to run firmware. The emulator uses a separate browser worker for each session.
oledBlank: The emulated OLED is initially blank.
instrumentCaption: The OLED shows firmware output. Control inputs inject recorded GPIO, ADC and UART paths; pressure and audio remain incomplete.
formatNote: APP1 starts at the application handoff. Full flash starts at resident entry. ROM and DCD execution are not included.
sdNote: Choose raw, read-only images from 256 KiB to 128 MiB, in 256 KiB units. Compressed files are not supported. Files stay in this browser; filesystem compatibility is unverified.
sdChangeNote: Pause before changing cards. Applying changed cards starts a new session from the selected firmware and discards this session’s virtual flash changes.
sdPendingNote: Card changes are ready. Apply cards to start a new session. The current session remains available until the new load succeeds.
sdReadError: The card image could not be read. Select it again. The current session is unchanged.
sdSizeError: Choose a raw image from 256 KiB to 128 MiB in exact 256 KiB units. The current session is unchanged.
modelInitial: Load a firmware file to inspect this session’s model limits.
traceNote: JSON with firmware identity, execution and model limits.
controlNote: Hold a pad with a pointer, Enter or Space. These injected levels test firmware input paths; they do not reproduce physical velocity or calibrated pressure.
encoderNote: VALUE TURN selects raw encoder phase 0–3. It does not generate calibrated detents.
inputNote: For buttons, 1 is held and 0 is released. Knob and pad values are normalized model inputs.
usbNote: Send a 64-byte hexadecimal HID report to this session’s emulated firmware, or read its current USB status. USB support depends on the loaded build and the peripheral model.
traceLimits: CPU and peripheral coverage are incomplete; inspect unknown MMIO accesses and faults.
APP1 begins at the resident handoff; full flash begins at resident entry. ROM and DCD execution are not included.
GPIO/ADC/UART inputs are injected levels. Physical pressure, electrical settling and audio modelling remain incomplete.
Emulator results do not establish physical boot, recovery, audio or firmware-update success.
updateNote: Choose an R13, R14 or R15 APP1 binary and its package manifest. The updater checks the image, writes this session’s virtual flash and verifies a fresh boot. Files stay in this browser.
updateNoCandidate: Choose the APP1 file and its package manifest.
updateWaiting: Start a supported firmware session before updating.
updateReceipt: A successful update includes flash verification and a fresh boot. Export trace retains the receipt.
updateCancelled: Update cancelled. This session was stopped and its virtual flash was discarded. Start again from the selected firmware.
updateCancelNote: Cancel stops this session and discards its virtual flash.
updateNoReceipt: No update has completed in this session.
